profile.summary: XhmikosR is a **Senior JavaScript developer** with deep expertise in **Node.js and npm CLI internals**, specializing in **dependency management, security auditing, and CI/CD optimization**. Their contributions demonstrate strong **modern JavaScript (ES6+) knowledge**, particularly in **string manipulation and path resolution**, as well as **documentation improvements** (Gatsby.js, CHANGELOG updates). The developer shows **practical DevOps skills** through GitHub Actions enhancements, CI caching, and legacy tooling cleanup. While frontend frameworks aren’t directly evident, their involvement with **Gatsby.js** suggests familiarity with **React/JSX**. The profile highlights **back-end focus**, **code quality attention**, and **collaborative contributions** across the Node.js ecosystem.
